messages:
maria: Quick check — can we lock ARB for next Wed 3pm PT? Need facilitator + 2 reviewers. I'm out that day but can prep the agenda if someone picks facil.
aj: I can facilitate if nobody else wants it. 3pm PT works for me.
kevin: +1 to aj as facilitator. I'd like to bring a short RFC about caching tiers (10 min).
olivia: I can take reviewer slot. Will update the meeting doc with the RFC summary and pre-reads.
sam: Heads up I have a pager on-call that day — might be flaky. If we need reliable coverage, maybe pick a backup facilitator too.
maria: good call. can we have a backup? 
aj: volunteer backup: kevin can step in if I get pulled. kevin: yep, I can be backup.
olivia: I'll add a tiny facilitator checklist to the doc so backups can hop in smoothly.
maria: docs link: https://redwood-internal/notebooks/arb-meetings/agenda-2026 <-- please add prereads.
kevin: suggested agenda (short):
```
1) 5m - roll call + housekeeping
2) 10m - caching tiers RFC (kevin) - preread linked
3) 15m - platform standards: model-serving config alignment (aj)
4) 10m - ops/troubleshooting patterns (open)
5) 5m - action items + next steps
```
aj: can we standardize the per-item expected artifacts? e.g., RFC link, impact summary, rollback plan. makes review faster.
olivia: adding a tiny template now: "RFC link | TL;DR (<=2 sentences) | Risks | Rollback plan | Owners"
sam: also suggest adding "Expected decision" field so folks know what to prepare.
maria: agreed. olivia, can you add those fields and tag folks for preread by Mon EOD?
olivia: yes, will tag.
rota-bot: Reminder created: ARB meeting scheduled for 2026-03-xx 15:00 PT. Facilitator: aj. Backup facilitator: kevin. Reviewers: olivia, kevin. Pre-reads due: Mon EOD.
aj: thanks — I'll send a short facilitation note in the doc with checkpoints (start on time, enforce 10m slots, capture decisions).
kevin: one more ask — can we reserve the last 5 mins for "standards backlog" triage? quick wins only.
maria: ok reserve it.
olivia: done, pre-reads + template live. tagging: @kevin @aj @sam.
sam: I might drop in late, i'll catch the recording if needed. good plan. :thumbsup:
maria: great. I'll follow up with calendar invite + recording link. Thanks everyone.
aj: thanks — see you all next Wed. :clap:
